title: Vibrant Garlicky Brazilian Cheese Wrap
description: A romantic Brazilian dish featuring garlicky and crumbly cheese, wrapped in a ssam-wrap and infused with orange juice, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the crumbly Brazilian cheese and cook, stirring occasionally, until melted and slightly browned.
Stir in the orange juice, salt, and black pepper.
Warm the ssam-wrap sheets by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Spoon about 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture onto the center of each ssam-wrap sheet.
Fold the bottom half of the ssam-wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up to form a tight cylinder.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
